messages:
From: Elena Costa <elena.costa@dataworks.co>

Cc: procurement@dataworks.co
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 14:02:00 -0500
Subject: DataWorks - DPA intake and subprocessor details

Hi Stephanie,

We're kicking off the privacy intake for the upcoming integration between DataWorks and Redwood. Legal asked me to get a copy of Redwood's standard DPA template and a current list of subprocessors (hosting, monitoring, logging, analytics). A few items we need to confirm up front:

- Do you have an EU data residency option for customers?
- Which subprocessors have access to cleartext customer data (if any)?
- Preferred signing mechanism (DocuSign vs AdobeSign); our procurement prefers AdobeSign but can use DocuSign if necessary.

If you can send the template and the subprocessor list, I'll run it through our intake team and flag any immediate concerns. Our timeline is tight: we'd like to close the DPA in the next two weeks if possible.

Thanks — happy to set a quick 20-min call if that helps.

Best,
Elena Costa
Head of Legal
DataWorks

Attachment: None (requesting your template)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Costa <elena.costa@dataworks.co>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, michael_grant@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: DataWorks - DPA intake and subprocessor details

Elena —

Thanks for the note. Attaching our standard DPA and the current subprocessor register so your team can review. High-level answers to your questions below:

- EU data residency: Yes. For customers on Dedicated or Private deployments we support EU-only tenancy and data residency; for Hosted API customers we offer EU-region hosting with contractual safeguards and SCCs when required.
- Subprocessors with potential access to customer data: primary cloud provider (GCP), managed monitoring (LogStream Inc. — access to metrics/aggregated logs; does not retain PII for >30 days), and a small analytics vendor (Querylytics) used for anonymized usage metrics. Full list attached.
- Signing: We have an established DocuSign flow but can execute via AdobeSign upon request. If you prefer AdobeSign we just need the envelope/recipient fields mapped.

Next steps I propose:
1) Your team reviews attached Redwood_DPA_template_v1.docx and subprocessor_list_202601.csv and sends back any redlines or specific questions.
2) If there are material redlines, we can set a short call with our legal ops (cc'd Michael) to triage.
3) Confirm preferred signing path (DocuSign vs AdobeSign) and we will send the execution package.

I've attached an editable DPA and the subprocessor list. Also looping in Grace (GDPR intake) and Michael (legal ops) for visibility — they'll help with any transfer mechanism or SCC questions.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales Operations (Privacy Liaison)
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com

From: Elena Costa <elena.costa@dataworks.co>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@dataworks.co, matthew.barnes@dataworks.co
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 11:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: DataWorks - DPA intake and subprocessor details

Stephanie — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the attachments. A couple of clarifying questions from our intake:

1) For hosted customers in the EU region, do you rely on SCCs alone or do you offer any additional contractual transfer mechanism? Our privacy team asks specifically about: backup locations, cross-border disaster recovery, and any third-party log retention outside the EU.
2) The subprocessor register shows LogStream Inc. — can you confirm whether they process any customer-provided PII and the retention period for logs?
3) We anticipate a few minor redlines on audit scope and a small change in the liability carve-out. Would Redwood accept an initial redline set that we mark as "non-negotiable" vs "commercial" so we can speed review?

Procurement also flagged that we prefer AdobeSign given our internal tooling — would you be able to route the final DPA through AdobeSign? If so we will provide the envelope contact.

Attaching our standard security questionnaire (curated) so you can pre-check the answers that will likely surface during the intake.

If it helps, Michael or Grace can join a 20-min slot next week to walk through the transfer questions.

Regards,
Elena Costa
Head of Legal
DataWorks

Attachment: DataWorks_Security_Q_202601.pdf (pdf, 180KB)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Costa <elena.costa@dataworks.co>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, michael_grant@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 10:14:00 -0500
Subject: Re: DataWorks - DPA intake and subprocessor details

Elena —

Thanks for the questions and for the questionnaire — useful detail. Quick answers and proposed execution path below.

1) EU hosted & transfers: For EU-region hosted customers we operate within EU data centers and we execute SCCs for any cross-border processing. For disaster recovery we maintain encrypted backups; for EU-tenants backups are also stored in EU zones. We are happy to include a clause confirming backup locality for DataWorks in the DPA.

2) LogStream Inc.: They process observability data and aggregated logs. They do not ingest customer PII as a purposeful data sink. Retention is 30 days by default; logs are stored in the region of the tenant for Dedicated/Private; for Hosted customers we can commit 30-day retention and provide a dataflow note showing storage region.

3) Redlines: We generally accept a two-track review — please mark clauses as "non-negotiable" vs "commercial". For the liability carve-out, our legal ops prefers to handle proposed changes in a single redline document so we can triage quickly; Michael will coordinate.

Signing path: We have both flows available. DocuSign link (preferred for our ops automation): https://docusign.com/envelope/1234567890
Alternative (AdobeSign) if you need it: https://adobesign.com/agreements/AS-99887766 — tell us which envelope you want us to use and we'll route accordingly.

I've attached a short execution checklist to speed the intake and proposed a 20-min call Wednesday 21 Jan at 10:00 ET — Grace and Michael can join. Please confirm if that works or propose alternate times.

Thanks — we'll standby for your redlines and preferred signing method.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales Operations (Privacy Liaison)
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com

Attachments:
- DPA_execution_checklist.pdf (pdf, 14KB)
